department.narrative: The UK's Department of Health and Social Care (DHSC) helps people to live more independent, healthier lives for longer. Our official development assistance (ODA) funded programmes take this objective beyond the UK to address global health challenges for the benefit of people living in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs).
